import sys

class TextDocumentAnalysis:
    @staticmethod
    def input(s: str) -> str:
        max_len = 0
        words = 0
        open = False
        n = len(s)
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            c = s[i]
            if c == '_' or c == '(' or c == ')':
                if c == '(':
                    open = True
                elif c == ')':
                    open = False
                i += 1
            else:
                start = i
                while i < n and s[i] != '_' and s[i] != '(' and s[i] != ')':
                    i += 1
                length = i - start
                if i < n:
                    d = s[i]
                    if d == '(':
                        if length > max_len:
                            max_len = length
                        open = True
                    elif d == ')':
                        words += 1
                        open = False
                    else:  # d == '_'
                        if open:
                            words += 1
                        else:
                            if length > max_len:
                                max_len = length
                else:
                    if open:
                        words += 1
                    else:
                        if length > max_len:
                            max_len = length
        return f"{max_len} {words}"

def main():
    need_second = False
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.rstrip('\n')
        if need_second:
            print(TextDocumentAnalysis.input(line))
        need_second = not need_second
    if need_second:
        raise RuntimeError("No such element")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
